Package model.filesystem

package model.filesystem
Provides a richer Unix-style in-memory file system model.

This package includes abstractions for directories, files, permissions, inodes, bitmaps, and a super block. It is intended to support shell-like operations such as creating files, writing content, listing directories, changing permissions, moving entries, copying files, searching, and reporting storage statistics.

The implementation is educational and runs in memory. It focuses on showing how file system structures interact rather than replacing the operating system's real file system.
